% Adapted from TeX Live 2025 TKZdoc-euclide-lines.tex, tangent examples.
\documentclass[varwidth=true,border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{tkz-euclide}

\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}[scale=.75]
  \tkzDefPoints{0/0/O,0/3/A,6/-1/E}
  \tkzDrawCircle[teal](O,A)
  \tkzDrawSegment[gray](O,A)

  % The one-point result determines the tangent direction at A.
  \tkzDefLine[tangent at=A](O)\tkzGetPoint{H}
  \tkzDrawLine[add=3 and 3,red](A,H)
  \tkzMarkRightAngle[fill=teal!30](O,A,H)

  % The two-point result is ordered by the directed external/contact/center angle.
  \tkzDefLine[tangent from=E](O,A)\tkzGetPoints{T1}{T2}
  \tkzDrawSegments[blue](E,T1 E,T2)
  \tkzDrawPoints[red](O,A,E,T1,T2)
  \tkzLabelPoints(O,A,E,T1,T2)
  \tkzLabelPoints[left](H)
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
